title: 12 Best Chengdu's Ancient Teahouse Culture
description: Discover the 12 best ancient teahouses in Chengdu, from lively park settings to serene temple courtyards. Immerse yourself in authentic Sichuan tea culture and local life.

places.name: Hemin Teahouse (鹤鸣茶社)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A cup of Jasmine Tea (Moli Hua Cha) paired with traditional crispy sunflower seeds.

places.name: Shunxing Old Teahouse (顺兴老茶馆)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy a pot of Gaiwan Tea while watching the Sichuan Opera performance. Their dim sum is also highly recommended.

places.name: Wenshu Monastery Teahouse (文殊院茶座)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic cup of Biluochun green tea and their famous vegetarian spring rolls.

places.name: Wangjianglou Park Teahouse (望江楼公园茶馆)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A simple pot of Tieguanyin oolong tea, enjoyed with the calming sounds of the river.

places.name: Xiangzi Li Teahouse (香子丽茶馆)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their specialty 'Kung Fu Tea' service, where tea is ceremonially prepared and poured.

places.name: Qingyang Palace Teahouse (青羊宫茶馆)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Chrysanthemum tea, known for its calming properties, served in a simple gaiwan.

places.name: Yuelai Teahouse (悦来茶馆)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any local green tea, and if available, try to catch a snippet of a traditional performance.

places.name: Jingli Ancient Street Teahouses (锦里古街茶馆群)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Local Sanpao Tai tea (Three Pao Tea) and a variety of Sichuan street snacks from nearby stalls.

places.name: Daci Temple Teahouse (大慈寺茶馆)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Green tea or herbal tea, accompanied by light Buddhist-inspired vegetarian snacks.

places.name: San Sheng Xiang Zai Yuan (三圣乡枣园)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Freshly brewed local green tea, often served with a selection of farm-fresh snacks or a simple meal.

places.name: Jinsha Site Museum Teahouse (金沙遗址博物馆茶馆)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Sichuan green tea, perhaps paired with a light pastry or local snack from their menu.

places.name: Chunxi Road Public Teahouse (春熙路露天茶馆)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any standard local green tea. The experience is more about the atmosphere than the specific brew.
